You have attempted this same task before and did not succeed. These are the plans you wrote after those attempts.
Trial #1: New plan: I failed because I repeatedly tried to take items (cauldron, wands, ingredients) that were not present in the current room, and I ignored the fact that the necessary objects might be in other locations or require specific interactions. I also misinterpreted the game's response to "look at" commands as errors when they were simply unimplemented features. The correct strategy is to first identify the location of every ingredient and tool listed in the recipe by systematically checking all visible objects and moving to adjacent rooms (like the reading room) if needed. Only after confirming the presence of the cauldron, wands, and ingredients should I attempt to take them. I must also strictly follow the recipe steps in order: take the cauldron, then sequentially take each ingredient, then use the wands, and finally add the last ingredient. I will stop attempting to take non-existent items immediately and focus on navigation and inventory management.

Trial #2: New plan: I failed because I repeatedly attempted to take items (cauldron, wands) that were not in my current room or were inaccessible, and I ignored the gravity mechanic in the magic workshop which made items float to the ceiling. I also failed to systematically locate the cauldron and the specific wands (fairy, ice, fire) before trying to use them. The correct strategy is to first navigate to the kitchen to retrieve the cauldron and the banana, then return to the magic workshop. Once there, I must carefully observe the floating items on the ceiling, put down my current inventory to free up space, and then sequentially take the required wands (fairy, ice, fire) and the green beetle from the garden. Only after gathering all components in the correct order will I attempt to brew the potion. I will stop immediately if an item is not visible or takeable, and prioritize moving to the correct room before attempting to interact with objects.

Trial #3: New plan: I failed because I repeatedly attempted to take the cauldron while holding other items, ignoring the strict 2-item inventory limit, and I did not verify the exact location of the cauldron before trying to take it. The cauldron is in the kitchen, but I was often holding wands or ingredients. I must first ensure my inventory is empty (drop all items) before attempting to take the cauldron. Once I have the cauldron, I will navigate to the garden to get the green beetle, then return to the kitchen. Only then will I attempt to take the spider (from the outhouse) and the banana (from the pantry), ensuring I drop previous items to make space. Finally, I will return to the kitchen, add all ingredients to the cauldron, and use the wands in the correct order. I will stop immediately if an item is not takeable and prioritize clearing inventory before interacting with the cauldron.

New plan: I will first navigate to the kitchen and drop all items currently in my inventory to ensure I have space to take the cauldron. Once I have the cauldron, I will systematically collect the required ingredients in the order specified by the recipe: the spider (from the outhouse), the green beetle (from the garden), the banana (from the pantry), and the eye of newt (from the pantry). After gathering all ingredients, I will return to the kitchen, add them to the cauldron one by one, and finally use the fairy wand, ice wand, and fire wand in the correct sequence to brew the potion. I will strictly avoid attempting to take items that are not visible or accessible in the current room.
